title: Beijing Bar Launches Token Free Drinking: Get Free DeepSeek V4 Flash Computing Power by Connecting to Wi-Fi

content_html:
AGI Bar, a bar in Beijing that focuses on programmer interactions, has recently introduced a unique service called "Token Free Drinking." After making a purchase and connecting to the store's Wi-Fi, customers can get free API access to the DeepSeek V4 Flash model, with unlimited calls, and all reasoning is done locally.

According to information released by AGI Bar, the bar has purchased NVIDIA DGX Spark AI workstations to provide DeepSeek V4 Flash computing power. Customers just need to obtain the Base URL and API Key provided by the store, and they can directly call the model in development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Cherry Studio that support OpenAI API format, experiencing it almost indistinguishable from a cloud API.

From online tools to offline consumer scenarios, AI computing power is becoming "tangible."

Public information shows that AGI Bar was founded by people who have long been involved in the AI startup field, and currently has one store each in Beijing and Shanghai. David Holz, the founder of Midjourney, visited AGI Bar and exchanged with developers during his previous visit to mainland China, indicating the influence of this bar within the AI community.

This service signifies that AI applications are extending from traditional online software tools into real-world consumer scenarios. When developers can run code using top open-source models while sipping beer, "computing power" has become a kind of storefront infrastructure like Wi-Fi for the first time. Although this is still an exploratory attempt in a single commercial space, as the cost of large model inference continues to decline, in the future, more cafes, bars, and co-working spaces may include AI computing power as standard services. When Tokens are as easy to use as tap water, the most down-to-earth entrance for AI accessibility might be hidden in a glass of craft beer at the corner of the street.

content_html_zh:
北京一家专注于程序员互动的酒吧AGI Bar最近推出了一项名为“免代币畅饮”的独特服务。 购买并连接到商店的 Wi-Fi 后，客户可以免费访问 DeepSeek V4 Flash 模型的 API，无限调用，所有推理均在本地完成。

据AGI酒吧公布的信息，该酒吧采购了NVIDIA DGX Spark AI工作站，提供DeepSeek V4 Flash算力。 客户只需获取商店提供的Base URL和API Key，就可以直接在支持OpenAI API格式的Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Cherry Studio等开发工具中调用模型，体验与云端API几乎无异。

从线上工具到线下消费场景，AI算力正在变得“有形”。

公开信息显示，AGI Bar由长期涉足AI创业领域的人士创立，目前在北京和上海各拥有一家门店。 Midjourney创始人David Holz在上次访问中国大陆时曾到访AGI Bar并与开发者进行交流，可见该酒吧在AI社区中的影响力。

这项服务标志着人工智能应用正在从传统的在线软件工具延伸到现实世界的消费场景。 当开发者可以一边喝着啤酒一边使用顶级开源模型运行代码时，“算力”第一次成为了像Wi-Fi一样的一种店面基础设施。 虽然这仍是单一商业空间的探索性尝试，但随着大模型推理成本不断下降，未来更多的咖啡馆、酒吧、联合办公空间可能会将AI算力作为标配服务。 当Token像自来水一样好用时，AI无障碍最接地气的入口可能就藏在街角的一杯精酿啤酒里。
